ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let res;
let book_id = String(book.bookUrl).split('/').pop();
let sources = String(baseUrl).match(/chapterlist\/([a-z]+)\//);
sources = sources ? sources[1] : "";
let path = api[0] + "/api/content/" + sources + "/" + book_id;

try {
  res = JSON.parse(result).data.chapterList;
} catch(err) {
  java.log("解析异常：" + err);
  res = [];
}

let chapterList = [];
res.forEach((item, i) => {
	
  let Vname = item.volume_name;
  let time = item.update_titme;
  let words = item.word_number + "字";
  let Info = `${Vname} | ${time} | ${words}`;
  
  if (item.isCache) {
    Info = "🍓" + Info;
  }
  
  chapterList.push({
    title: item.title,
    url: path + '/' + item.item_id,
    info: Info
  });
});

chapterList;
</js>
